text:
Devon: Quick heads up — multiple high-touch onboarders (AcmeCorp, BrightLearn, NovaDocs, EduStack) hit an ingestion failure during their initial bulk push between 02:15–02:35 UTC. I'm drafting comms. Anyone see objections to a single consolidated status + VIP follow-ups?
Marie: Thanks. Can you share the quick impact summary so I can start VIP drafts?
Sam: SRE update: we saw short-lived S3 auth token expirations on the uploader fleet during that window. Mitigated by failover at 02:40 UTC. No customer data deleted; some chunks required manual retry. Root cause still being validated (token rotation timing + race).
Devon: Good to know. Recommended customer-facing points: what happened, what we did to fix, verification status, rollback/mitigation steps they can try, and offer of live troubleshooting.
AJ: Agree. For renewal-risk accounts we should include an exec summary + an exact timeline. Propose 5% credit for affected billing period for those 4 customers and priority onboarding support. Thoughts?
Marie: :thumbsup: I support the credit + priority office hours. I'll personalize VIP notes. Would like a short technical appendix for their engineering leads.
Sam: Will produce a short timeline and logs snippet. Example log we found: `uploader-job: token refresh failed: 401 - rotation window mismatch` — then retries succeeded. Planning patch for uploader's token refresh retry logic; target deploy by EOD.
Devon: Draft outline for general comms (to all affected): 1) Incident summary, 2) What we did to fix, 3) Verification steps, 4) When we expect a full RCA, 5) Offer office hours + credit. I'll push a first draft in 20m.
Marie: For VIPs, include a link to a scheduled 1-hr office hours block: Mon 15:00 UTC. I'll send calendar invites after draft approved. :spiral_calendar: 
Sam: Also adding a temporary monitoring alert to catch any token rotation anomalies in the next 72h.
Devon: ops-bot — please create an incident on status page and include the draft summary link.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20260323-42 — https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/INC-20260323-42
AJ: Good. Action items: Sam to attach logs + ETA for patch (by 10:30 UTC), Marie to draft VIP email (by 11:00 UTC), Devon to draft general comms and segment affected tenants (by 11:15 UTC). I'll approve credit once we have the final affected list.
Marie: I'll also capture customer feedback during office hours with a short form and feed it into the onboarding backlog.
Devon: Will we need a follow-up webinar or recorded walkthrough for bigger onboarding gaps? Could be useful for EduStack.
Marie: Let's gauge feedback first, but tentatively yes — collect requests during office hours and decide.
Sam: One more technical note — ingestion retries were successful for 90% of batches; 10% required manual re-ingest. We'll include re-ingest status per tenant in the VIP appendix.
Devon: Perfect. If no objections I'll post the customer note at 11:30 UTC and send VIPs individualized notes + invites immediately after.
AJ: No objections from me. Thanks team. :eyes:
Marie: I'll loop in Solutions Engineering on the VIP appendix. Devon, ping me when draft is ready for review.
Devon: Will do — drafting now.
_metadata_note: This thread is internal coordination for outbound incident communications to affected onboarders. Messages are short as in Slack style; timestamps are indicated in metadata only.
